decision.email_subject: Your Software Engineer application at SmartHire
decision.email_body:
Hi John,

Thank you for your interest in the Software Engineer position at SmartHire and for the time you spent on your application. After careful review, we have decided not to move forward with your application for this role, as other candidates more closely match its current requirements.

We appreciate your interest in SmartHire and wish you every success in your search.

Best regards,
SmartHire Recruiting Team
